ei.title: Chapter 1-05: Supertasters' Taste Sensitivity and Health
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본1

fullPassage: Supertasters and nontasters respond similarly to many foods, but supertasters are more sensitive to certain sweet and bitter substances. These differences in taste sensitivity influence people's eating habits in ways that can have repercussions for their physical health. For example, supertasters are less likely to be fond of sweets and tend to consume fewer high-fat foods, both of which are likely to reduce their risk for cardiovascular disease. Supertasters also tend to react more negatively to alcohol and smoking, thereby reducing their likelihood of developing drinking problems or nicotine addiction. The only health disadvantage identified for supertasters thus far is that they respond more negatively to many vegetables, which seems to hold down their vegetable intake. Overall, however, supertasters tend to have better health habits than nontasters, thanks to their strong reactions to certain tastes.

❌ ③ overall — 전반적으로 (인과관계 부적합)
❌ ④ thus far — 지금까지는 (시간 부사, 인과 아님)

questions.passage: Supertasters and nontasters respond similarly to many foods, but supertasters are more sensitive to certain sweet and bitter substances. These differences in taste sensitivity influence people's eating habits in ways that can have __________ for their physical health. For example, supertasters are less likely to be fond of sweets and tend to consume fewer high-fat foods, both of which are likely to reduce their risk for cardiovascular disease. Supertasters also tend to react more negatively to alcohol and smoking, thereby reducing their likelihood of developing drinking problems or nicotine addiction. The only health disadvantage identified for supertasters thus far is that they respond more negatively to many vegetables, which seems to hold down their vegetable intake. Overall, however, supertasters tend to have better health habits than nontasters, thanks to their strong reactions to certain tastes.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 미각 민감도 차이가 식습관에 영향을 미쳐 신체 건강에 '파장'을 가져올 수 있다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① substances — 물질 (건강에 대한 물질이 아닌 결과)
❌ ② reactions — 반응 (건강에 미치는 영향이지 반응 아님)
✅ ③ repercussions — 파장, 영향 ←정답
❌ ④ disadvantages — 불리한 점 (have disadvantages for는 부적합한 콜로케이션)
